# The Tribune

> > Leading North Indian news publication covering Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh, and Jammu & Kashmir with comprehensive reporting on politics, crime, entertainment, and regional affairs.

Founded by Sardar Dyal Singh Majithia, The Tribune is one of India's oldest English-language newspapers, providing in-depth coverage of North Indian states including Punjab, Haryana, and J&K. The publication serves as a primary news source for regional politics, law enforcement, entertainment including Bollywood and Pollywood, and cross-border issues with Pakistan.

## Key Topics

- Punjab politics and governance
- Haryana Assembly elections
- Law and order issues
- Drug smuggling and counter-intelligence
- Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)
- Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)
- Amritsar regional news
- Chandigarh administration
- Bollywood and Pollywood entertainment
- Election Commission directives
- Women's welfare schemes
- Cross-border relations with Pakistan
- Road accidents and public safety
- Punjab Budget and fiscal policy
- Bathinda and Moga districts
